blocks.text:
## Accommodation and meals

2 nights at a hotel according to the agreed programme. Days 2 and 3 begin with breakfast. The itinerary lists dinner with the Rafain show, lunch at the park restaurant and an evening of Argentine asado with wine. The final price and the services included are confirmed in your trip quotation.

## Flight over the falls

An optional 10-minute helicopter flight can be added. Its price is agreed separately.

## Programme quotation

Price on request. Dates, hotel, group size, meals and admission tickets are agreed when booking. Excursions are conducted in a group with an English-speaking guide; airport transfers are provided by a driver.
